verdict.line: You lose if you walk up for autos into Blinding Dart and poke; you win if you farm through it and show up with Fury of the Sands after level 6.

brief.thesis: Teemo's Toxic Shot poisons on every auto with no cooldown, so he wins any extended trade at range while your Q (Siphoning Strike) only has 255 range. The matchup is decided by whether you let him farm you down from outside your reach or refuse the fight, soak Spirit Fire resets, and convert at 6 and again once Fury of the Sands is up.

theirWindow.what: He can blind you before you swing, turning off your next auto and Siphoning Strike damage, then kite with Toxic Shot stacks while Move Quick keeps him clear of your W (Wither).

yourWindow.when: His Blinding Dart is on cooldown (8s) and you're level 6+
yourWindow.what: Land Wither to strip his Move Quick movement speed and attack speed, then commit — he has no blind to stop the engage and no gap-closer to escape Wither's slow.

start.why: The regen and damage reduction on autos directly offset Toxic Shot's poison ticks and Blinding Dart's chip, letting you stand in lane longer to stack Siphoning Strike kills.

boots.why: Magic resist cuts both Toxic Shot's over-time damage and Noxious Trap burst, and the tenacity shortens how long Wither-adjacent slows and blind effects from his kit linger on you.

core.why: Gives the stat spike and burst needed to punish his low base health once Fury of the Sands or Wither lands.
Amplifies Soul Eater lifesteal healing against his sustained poison damage over time.
The attack speed slow helps you close the range gap and reduces incoming poke frequency once he's forced into melee range.

situational.when: he and his team stack magic damage poke beyond lane
he builds into on-hit or you need the grievous wounds to cut his sustain

runes.keystoneWhy: The heal-on-hit and movement speed proc let you absorb poke damage while closing distance, which is the core problem this lane presents.

summoners.why: Ghost closes the gap Teemo's range and Move Quick otherwise maintain, while Teleport lets you reset for Spirit Fire stacks and return to lane without losing farm to his poke.

playing.title: Farm behind minions
playing.detail: Let your minions tank Blinding Dart's line of sight and Toxic Shot autos; only step up for Siphoning Strike when the wave is pushing into him.

playing.title: Track his Blinding Dart timer
playing.detail: 8 second cooldown — if he's just used it, that's your window to walk up and trade autos before he can blind you again.

playing.title: Drop Spirit Fire on cooldown
playing.detail: Spirit Fire's 12 second cooldown and armor shred both accelerate your Q stacking and punish any extended stand-and-poke attempt he makes.

playing.title: Save Wither for engage, not farm
playing.detail: Wither's 700 range lets you cut his Move Quick speed before he can disengage — hold it until you're actually committing to a kill, not just poking.

playing.title: Play for level 6 and 11 power spikes
playing.detail: Fury of the Sands' health drain and attack range increase let you tank through his poison and close distance; don't force fights before you have it up.

playing.title: Respect Noxious Trap zoning
playing.detail: He can drop traps at 230 range with effectively no cooldown — check for mushrooms before diving in for a kill, since the slow and damage over time can turn a winning trade.

playing.title: Push waves to deny his camouflage resets
playing.detail: Forcing him to react to lane pressure keeps him from standing still long enough to go Invisible and reset Element of Surprise attack speed.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, and summoner spells reflect measured win rates on the current patch (50.4% overall, 50.4% in 1634 head-to-head games); the mechanical reasoning and timing calls are my own tactical read.

stats.opponentTip: Do not step within Teemo’s range to avoid being punished. Allow Teemo to gain lane control while focusing on farming with [Q], and try go in for the kill post-level 6 with Unsealed Spellbook + Fury of the Sands [R].
